title: Testing, certification and maintenance
summary: Periodic inspection, thermal surveys, RCD testing and planned maintenance for occupied premises.
body: A test should produce a work list, not a folder of numbers. We inspect and test to IS 10101, photograph every defect, and price the remedials in the same visit. Landlords and facility managers get a dated report they can act on.
deliverables: Periodic inspection and test report with photographic defects
Thermal survey of boards and submains under load
RCD and emergency lighting function tests
Prioritised remedial schedule with fixed prices
leadTime: Single-day inspection; report within five working days
